name: Erin
source:
A merchant who travels around the country and meets Lily in an undeveloped land.

With a bright and strong personality, she immediately connects anything to business and troubles others.

Lily's friend who later hires Cuff and T reasure then goes on a pilgrimage trip.

"Anyway, first of all, money!"
